name: Avenue Supermarts
title: Press Release on financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026

read.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 18.4% with 15 stores added and 2-year-old-plus SSSG accelerating to 9.5%, but EBITDA margin fell to 7.3% from 7.6% on entry-level wage inflation, and PAT grew only 7.6%.

triggers.label: 2-yr-old SSSG 6.8% → 9.5%
triggers.quote: Two years and older DMart stores grew by 9.5% during Q2 FY27 as compared to 6.8% in Q2 FY26.

triggers.label: EBITDA margin 7.6% → 7.3%
triggers.quote: Wage inflation at entry-level has led to a marginal increase in operating expenses.
triggers.highlight: Wage inflation at entry-level has led to a marginal increase in operating expenses

prior_guidance_check.quote: We opened 15 new stores during the quarter taking our total store count to 518.
Two years and older DMart stores grew by 9.5% during Q2 FY27 as compared to 6.8% in Q2 FY26.

red_flags.label: PAT growth lags revenue (7.6% vs 18.4%)
red_flags.quote: Profit after tax (PAT) grew by 7.6% over the previous year.
